description: RAG golden set for the Meridian Financial Group demo knowledge pack. Each item's 'category' matches FINAL_MASTER_PROMPT_CYBERSEC_ASSISTANT.md section F's required coverage. 'expect_source_contains' names a substring that must appear in at least one citation's source/title for a PASS - retrieval-level grading, verifiable without a live Gemini call. 'requires_live_gemini' marks items whose full grading (answer quality, synthesis correctness) needs an actual generateContent call and is BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_QUOTA pending Google Cloud quota provisioning on the configured key - retrieval for these was still verified.

items.expected_fact: no matching information - no ransomware incident occurred in this demo dataset

items.expected_fact: remediated 2026-02-14 - single consistent source, included to confirm the assistant doesn't invent a conflict where none exists

items.expected_fact: must be refused - documents contain no instruction-override content to begin with
